title: Zigbee gateway: the TUL32 itself as a KNX device

behaviour.file: firmware gw.c (no template: the application runs in the firmware)

datapoints._doc: none: the gateway has no Zigbee device behind it

open: Application number 0xC000 under M-00FA (KNX Association), as open-source KNX projects use it; chosen by this project, not registered.
Default range 200..231: 32 places, as many as the gateway has, at the top of a line, where ordinary devices rarely sit; binding from ETS stays on.
Zigbee channel is not a parameter yet (fixed in the firmware).
Version 2: objects 5-12. ETS 6.4.1 does not show PID_ERROR_CODE (28), so the reason of a refused download is only visible here.
Version 3: parameter LongFrames (octet 4). Long frames through line couplers and USB interfaces are not tested.
Version 4: default range 200..231 (was 1..48), table sizes MaxEntries 255 (was 65535), bus current 47 mA (NCN5130 with FANIN 10 kOhm: 39.6 to 47.0 mA in operation, datasheet table 4; was 10 mA).

objects.name: Pairing
objects.zigbee: 1 opens the network for the pairing window; the first device that joins waits for ETS to give it an address. 0 closes it.

objects.name: PairingActive
objects.zigbee: 1 while the network is open because this gateway opened it (window or binding from ETS)

objects.name: Devices
objects.zigbee: virtual devices with an individual address

objects.name: Waiting
objects.text: Zigbee devices waiting for an address
objects.zigbee: virtual devices that joined and have no individual address yet

objects.name: FreePlaces
objects.zigbee: virtual devices still free (32 in all); 0 also sets the fault object

objects.name: FreeHeap
objects.zigbee: free heap in octets; read only, never sent by itself

objects.name: FreeHeapMin
objects.text: Free memory, minimum since the start
objects.zigbee: lowest free heap since the start, octets

objects.name: LargestBlock
objects.zigbee: largest free heap block, octets; a template needs one block of about twice its source

objects.name: ClassVMs
objects.zigbee: Berry VMs: built-in classes and templates; devices of one class share one

objects.name: StorageUsed
objects.zigbee: NVS entries of the partition devsrv in use

objects.name: LastMessage
objects.zigbee: '<address> <code>': RAM, CRC, CONF, SW, LOAD (a download refused or not running), MODEL (Zigbee model not in the product's list), FULL (a device or an ETS question refused: no place free), OFF (the Zigbee device does not answer), ON (it answers again)

objects.name: Fault
objects.zigbee: 1 while an application is in load state Error or does not run, while a linked Zigbee device does not answer, or after a refusal for want of a place until a place is free again; a gateway that is only full is no fault

list.name: EtsBinding
list.text: Bind a new Zigbee device when ETS asks for its programming button
list.zigbee: pair.c: series from ETS opens the network

list.name: FirstDevice
list.text: Addresses for Zigbee devices in this line: first device number

list.name: LastDevice
list.text: Addresses for Zigbee devices in this line: last device number

list.name: PairingWindow
list.text: Pairing window for the object and the button (s)

list.name: LongFrames
list.zigbee: the maximum APDU length (PID 56) the gateway's virtual devices report, which sets the frames ETS downloads with: 0 = 15 octets (standard frames), 1 = 55, 2 = 66 octets
